      • getGenerationPeriod

        int getGenerationPeriod()
        Sets the way the model will attempt to meet the gereration requiremnt at period (TIME-STEP, DAILY, WEEKLY). The valid values are GENERATION_PERIOD_DAILY, GENERATION_PERIOD_TIMESTEP, & GENERATION_PERIOD_WEEKLY. If any other value is passed in, an illegal argument exception is thrown.
